title: Magpylib Studio scene
description: A magnetic scene as an ordered log of the operations that built it. `events` is the document; `objects` is a projection of it that the engine regenerates on every build.

version.description: Format version. Absent means the first format, from before this field existed; a version higher than the engine knows is refused rather than half-read.

generator.description: What wrote this file, e.g. "magpylib-studio 0.1.0". Informational.

variables.description: Named numbers the scene is written in terms of. Any value below may be an expression over these instead of a number.

variable_bounds.description: What a variable is allowed to be. Hard min/max are limits; soft_min/soft_max are where the slider sits by default; `options` is for a variable that is a choice rather than a quantity.

integer.description: It counts things, so a fractional value is meaningless rather than merely precise.

options.description: The values this variable may take, when it is not on a scale at all — a rotation axis is the reason this exists. A UI offers these as a dropdown the way it offers min/max as a slider.

events.description: What built the scene, in order. Folding it from the start reproduces the scene exactly, ids included.

objects.description: DERIVED. The object tree the events describe, written out so a reader without an engine can see the scene. Regenerated on load — edits here are lost; edit the create event instead.

value.description: A number; an expression over the document's variables written with a leading '=' ("=360/n"); or a bare name, for a value that is a choice rather than a quantity (an axis is "z"). Expressions are evaluated from their syntax tree against an allow-list, never exec'd. A string that is neither — "360/n" without the '=' — is the mistake this shape exists to catch.

axis.description: An axis name, a vector, or an expression naming a variable that holds one. A name is a name — "z" is not a number.

vector.description: Three values, each a number or an expression.

style.description: magpylib style, as a dotted or nested tree.

visible.description: false hides the object in the 3D view. Hidden sources still contribute to the field.

objectType.description: A magpylib class, dotted from the magpylib root.

id.description: Stable id, so a step can be edited, moved or removed by name.

op.description: What happened. Absent means "rotate_from_angax", the original default.

parent.description: The collection it is created in.

children.description: Collections only: ids that already exist and are adopted.

parent.description: null moves it to the top level.

start.description: magpylib path index the move is written at.

anchor.description: Point rotated about; absent or null spins in place, 0 means the origin.

count.description: Copies including the original, so 8 means 8 objects.

spin.description: Extra rotation each copy makes in place — what turns a ring into a Halbach array.

step.description: Offset between neighbours. Twice along different steps is a grid.

normal.description: Used instead of `plane` for an arbitrary mirror.

anchor.description: A point on the mirror plane.
